input.free_text_description: This system is a job/recommendation platform that serves Candidate, Customer roles. It exposes interfaces for managing product, pocket, home. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to interact with product functionality, so that I can accomplish my product-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with pocket functionality, so that I can accomplish my pocket-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with home functionality, so that I can accomplish my home-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Customer, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
